import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='JUNpaMa'].copy()
ref=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')
# check all other instance families on 10/16 vs their own history (z-score)
g = a.groupby(['instance_family','date'])['unblended_cost'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
hist = g.loc[:, g.columns<g.columns.max()-pd.Timedelta(days=3)]
mu = hist.mean(axis=1); sd = hist.std(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan)
z = (g[ref]-mu)/sd
print(z.sort_values(ascending=False).head(8))
